convert_hotpot2squad: convert a HotpotQA JSON file to SQuAD format using the main CLI entry point
convert_example: convert a single HotpotQA example to SQuAD format with supporting facts and answer spans
run_conversion_script: run the script with --split hotpot_train_v1 to convert HotpotQA data to SQuAD format
convert_with_lower_context: convert a HotpotQA file with lower-cased context using the --context_is_lower flag
convert_bad_answer_example: convert a HotpotQA example with bad answers using the bad_answer_example parameter
